posts.author: SadOneGuy-San
posts.body:
Resource Type:
Tilesets (Exterior & Interior)
Maker Format:
RPG Maker MV (48x48)
Art Style:
Stylistic "Gilded Horror" (Painterly/Textured, matching WinLu’s atmosphere)
Primary Focus
​
Per moderator feedback, I am narrowing my search to the foundational architectural bones of this region. I am looking for pointers to existing assets or recommendations for:
Qing-style sweeping roof tiles
(with Doukou/bracket sets).
Modular Paifang Gates
(monumental Chinese-style gates).
Traditional Interior Latticework & Spirit Screens
(Zhaobi).
Note:
I am an artist myself (handling sprites/animations). I plan to manually "grit up" these assets, adding the autumnal rot and parasitic gold crystals myself. I just need a solid, historically accurate structural foundation to build upon.
This particular region is a 3-hour+ area in a systemic Soulslike RPG, fusing George Mcdonald's The Golden Key with the Chinese epic "Dream of the Red Chamber".
Core Visual Pillar:
Beautiful from afar, horror upclose
The Aesthetic:
An "Eternal Autumn" of cinnabar reds and dead golds. A "False Heaven" where architecture is a weapon of delusion.
The Vibe:
Lavish imperial paradise from a distance; peeling lacquer, jagged Amrita (Golden Kegare), and torn silk upon closer inspection.
Architectural Fusion:
Late Imperial China (Qing) foundations with the minimalist sensibilities of Heian-period Japan.
Resolution:
Custom 942 x 724 viewport (but assets must follow 48x48 grid).
Compatibility:
Recommendations for high-quality assets (even if originally for 816 x 624 / Ace resolution) are welcome, as I am prepared to adapt and upscale them for my custom parallax work.
I am looking for pointers toward existing resources (free or commercial) or potential collaborators interested in this specific aesthetic.
